# anyscale_iam_role_binding (Data Source)

~> **Beta.** Role bindings are enabled per organization by Anyscale while customers migrate; contact [support@anyscale.com](mailto:support@anyscale.com) to enable them. Beta resources may change incompatibly; every breaking change is listed in the changelog. See the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md#role-bindings-beta).

Reads every direct role binding on one organization, cloud or project, in the shape `anyscale_iam_role_binding` takes. Bindings held on a parent scope are not included. Reading requires managing IAM on the scope.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_id` (String) Read the bindings on this cloud. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`.
- `organization_id` (String) Read the bindings on the organization: the token's own, as returned by the `anyscale_organization` data source. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`.
- `project_id` (String) Read the bindings on this project. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<scope_type>/<scope_id>`, for example `project/prj_...`.
- `roles` (Attributes Map) Every direct binding on the scope, keyed by role ID (`rol_...`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `user_group_ids` (Set of String) User groups (`ug_...`) that hold the role. Null when none do.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) Users (`usr_...`) that hold the role. Null when none do.
